description: An upstream rate-limit reply (429 with retry-after) to a streamed Chat request reaches the client as a 429 with an error body built from the upstream's error type and message. The old core's Retry-After is its own cooldown estimate, so the header is masked here.

error.message: Number of request tokens has exceeded your per-minute rate limit

exceptions.reason: The new core answers a Chat client with OpenAI's error body, error.code holding Claude's error type and error.type server_error for a 5xx; today's core passes Claude's envelope (type error) through.
The new core answers a Chat client with OpenAI's error body, error.code holding Claude's error type and error.type server_error for a 5xx; today's core passes Claude's envelope (type error) through.
Today's core adds metadata.user_id, a hash it derives from the request, to every request it translates to Claude; the new core does not make up a user identifier for the client.

The Claude extension sends an API key in x-api-key, as Anthropic's API defines it; today's core sends it as a bearer token whenever the base URL is not api.anthropic.com (it uses x-api-key only there).
